status: proposal; no safety certification or engine implementation
units: metres, square metres, kW, kVA, people/minute, seconds, m/s

source_register.title: HSE venue and site design
source_register.scope: UK event guidance; not US code
source_register.summary: Capacity depends on layout, audience, exits and activities; ground/anchoring/underground services and wind exposure require assessment.

source_register.title: HSE crowd controls inside venue
source_register.summary: Keep attractions/queues out of circulation routes and avoid crowd pinch points and stage surges.

source_register.title: 2024 IBC Chapter 10 table 1004.5
source_register.status: verified official indexed excerpt; subsequent direct fetch failed
source_register.scope: Model-code reference only; local adoption/amendments unverified
source_register.summary: 5 net ft² standing; 7 net chairs only; 15 net tables/chairs. These calculate design occupant load, not a safe crowd-density standard.

source_register.title: Seattle Fire tent assembly permit conditions
source_register.status: verified official indexed table; direct reader internal error
source_register.scope: Seattle example permit conditions; local applicability unverified
source_register.summary: Tent exit count/width table and 100 ft travel-distance reference. Not a generic site exit certificate.

source_register.title: 2024 NC Fire Code Chapter 31
source_register.scope: North Carolina code edition example; local applicability unverified
source_register.summary: Tent aggregate width reference 0.2 inch per occupant and distributed exits within 100 ft travel.

source_register.title: US Access Board ADA Chapter 4
source_register.scope: US ADA technical standard; application/scoping requires review
source_register.summary: Accessible route 36 in minimum; walking slope <=1:20 and cross slope <=1:48; ramp rules separate.

source_register.title: US Access Board ADA Chapter 2
source_register.scope: US ADA scoping; fixed seating and portable-toilet clauses have distinct scope
source_register.summary: Portable clustered toilet exception uses 5%; fixed-seat wheelchair table and assistive-listening requirements are not interchangeable with loose-chair planning.

source_register.title: San Diego special event planning guide
source_register.status: verified municipal guide; PDF pp23,28,44 as printed
source_register.scope: San Diego local example; other local rules unverified
source_register.summary: 10% accessible restroom/sink facilities, at least one per location; public handwash additional to food-provider sinks; generators >=20 ft from tents and guarded from public.

source_register.title: CDC generator safety
source_register.summary: Keep combustion generators outside at least 20 ft from doors/windows/vents.

source_register.title: HSE electrical safety
source_register.scope: UK technical guidance; US electrical rules separately required
source_register.summary: Competent electrical design; segregated generator intake/enclosure; wet-environment suitability and cable protection.

source_register.title: OSHA occupational noise
source_register.scope: US occupational exposure; not city noise permit or audience loudness target
source_register.summary: 90 dBA eight-hour PEL, 5 dBA exchange; general-industry hearing conservation at85 dBA eight-hour TWA.

source_register.title: NWS lightning sports
source_register.summary: Named weather monitor, stop/shelter/resume plan; wait at least30 minutes after last thunder.

source_register.title: NWS lightning outdoors
source_register.summary: Tents and picnic shelters are not safe lightning refuges; substantial buildings or enclosed hard-topped vehicles are options.

source_register.title: NWS Event Ready Guide
source_register.summary: Determine warning, clearance and sheltering time; obtain facility wind thresholds; shelter suitability/capacity requires specialist review.

source_register.title: NWS WBGT vs Heat Index
source_register.scope: Heat-stress indicator; no single universal shutdown threshold
source_register.summary: WBGT accounts for heat, humidity, wind, cloud and sun; activity/acclimatization influence response.

source_register.title: HSE temporary structures
source_register.summary: Supplier/competent structural design and installed configuration determine load/anchoring/wind limits.

source_register.title: HSE crowd management controls
source_register.summary: Arrival, onsite circulation and departure are separate crowd-management phases.

input_contract.G: Peak simultaneously present GUESTS, not tickets sold or visits over a day
input_contract.S: Actual peak staff/crew/vendors; example only uses ceil(0.10*G)
input_contract.N: G+S+other people present, reconciled by zone/time
input_contract.code_design_occupant_load: Authority-approved load based on applicable occupancy rules. Never silently replace it with expected turnout. Null until reviewed.
input_contract.event_location: Site boundary, latitude/longitude, time zone, measured entrances and surveyed slopes
input_contract.existing_toilet_credit: Zero unless access, capacity, hours and permission are confirmed
input_contract.weather: Issue/valid time, freshness, observational vs forecast vs simulated provenance

operational_density_target.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

review_threshold.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

stop_admission_threshold.unit: people/m²; proposal trigger, not a universal safe limit
stop_admission_threshold.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

crowd.response: Any surge, distress, blocked exit or barrier pressure can require intervention below numerical thresholds. Capacity requires competent plan review.

code_occupant_load_factors.scope: Code design-load inputs where locally adopted; not operational crowd-density limits

reference_nonstair_width_m_per_person.scope: Tent reference in named code; local outdoor-site applicability unverified

tent_reference_table.scope: Tent-specific local reference; membrane structures may differ; counts do not alone certify capacity
tent_reference_table.occupants_3000: Exact table boundary ambiguous as printed (Over3000); require adopted-code clarification; do not interpolate silently

tent_travel_reference_m.scope: Actual walking route inside tent, not straight-line radius

egress.site_exit_target: Assumption: at least K independent distributed gates; sized provisionally using declared N. Check remaining clear capacity after widest gate loss; this is a planning robustness test, not universal code.
egress.calculation_status: Preliminary declared-population illustration only. Final design_occupant_load and downstream network unknown. No automatic PASS.
must_check: gate hardware, opening direction, no ticket checks on exit
evacuation/sheltering model and rehearsed operating plan
egress.estimated_clearance_time: Detection+decision+notification+premovement+max(travel, queue/discharge)+assistance time; flow rate and bottlenecks need competent input, no fixed persons/m/s assumption supplied

public_main_spine_m.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

secondary_accessible_route_m.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

route_technical_min_m.scope: ADA technical minimum; not adequate crowd-egress design by itself

passing_space.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

walk_slope_max.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

cross_slope_max.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

service_fire_lane.scope: San Diego example; local fire access width, turning, overhead clearance and surface load must be provided

tent_separation_target.unit: m clear before guy/ballast allowances are confirmed
tent_separation_target.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

generator_to_tent.scope: San Diego example; other adopted rules and supplier distances override

generator_to_opening.scope: CO guidance: outdoors, away from doors/windows/vents; wind/terrain can require more

power_public_fence_offset.scope: San Diego example around combustion source; equipment/vendor envelope may be larger

cooking_public_buffer_target.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

toilets_food_buffer_target.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

clearances.anchoring_envelope: Supplier footprint of ballast, guys, stakes and trip guards, then clear circulation envelope; unknown envelope cannot be marked clear

toilet_ratio.unit: people per toilet; <=4h, no alcohol draft
toilet_ratio.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

alcohol_or_longer_event_multiplier.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

sanitation.formula: T=max(2,ceil(N/75*duration_alcohol_multiplier)); distribute into B=ceil(T/12) banks (assumption). Accessible units=max(B,ceil(0.10*T)) with at least one per bank. Accessible units are included in T, not additional.

accessible_share.scope: San Diego local requirement; selected as proposal default everywhere. ADA portable-cluster exception5% has different scope; local stricter value prevails.

sanitation.handwash: H=max(B,ceil(T/4)); H_accessible=max(B,ceil(0.10*H)); public sinks do not replace separate food-service sinks. H ratio is assumption.
sanitation.bank_distribution: Keep every bank connected by firm/stable slip-resistant route; 0.02 cross-slope local sanitation example; queue kept out of egress; service pump access isolated.
sanitation.status: Ratios are illustrative planning allowances; peak use, gender mix, duration, alcohol, service interval and health department requirements can change counts

peak_arrival_fraction.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

lane_service_rate.scope: Proposal default; site-specific authority review required

queue.rule: Admission gates and queues cannot consume independent exit capacity; accessible queue route achieves same service, not segregated poorer experience; stop admission before holding capacity/spillback is exceeded
queue.status: Arrival and service measurements needed; no queue wait guarantee

power.sizing: List each load, voltage/phases, kW, power factor, starting/surge demand, simultaneity and operating hours; load schedule is required, not watts-per-guest
power.formula: illustrative running_kW=sum(part_count*example_running_kW); provisional_kVA=running_kW/(0.8PF*0.8loading); actual vendor generator must also meet starting currents, derating and redundancy
required: locally appropriate GFCI/RCD and wet-rated distribution
grounding/bonding based on system design; not automatic ground-rod rule
cable capacity/voltage drop and protected routes
verified combustion exhaust clearances; battery/shore power preferred where feasible

worker_reference.scope: OSHA occupational scope, not audience target or city noise limit

noise.rule: Aim speaker energy into intended audience and away from noise-sensitive boundaries; FOH measurements, audience/worker exposure and boundary measurements separate. Buildings/wind/low frequencies invalidate a simple distance circle.
noise.inverse_square_preview: Free-field point-source comparison only: deltaLp=-20log10(r2/r1), no absolute safe contour; line arrays, reflections and weather require acoustic model/measurement
noise.status: Local noise permit values unverified; no automatic compliance indication

weather.rain_plan: Accessible wet-weather surfaces + drainage + electrical protection; covered plan must have its own occupancy and exits. A tent is a comfort rain plan only within approved wind/weather operating conditions, not a severe-weather/ lightning shelter.

wind.status: unverified_site_value; do not populate generic wind/ballast numbers
wind.stop_rule: Operational action thresholds below the installed configuration limit must allow time to close/dismantle/evacuate; selected supplier/engineer plan defines them; adding sidewalls changes loads.

lightning.trigger: Thunder/lightning observed => stop and move to safe refuge; earlier detection buffer must be based on warning+clearance+shelter time, configured with weather lead
lightning.refuge: Capacity-confirmed substantial buildings or enclosed hard-topped vehicles; tents are never credited
lightning.no_safe_refuge: Do not approve opening/continuation without an actionable cancellation/early-clearance plan

heat.metric: WBGT where available; heat index clearly labelled if substituted
heat.status: unverified_site_value; site medical/weather lead defines activity/population thresholds

sun.position: Engine solar model using location, event date/time/timezone; do not use calibration sun as event sun
sun.shadow_length_formula: length=h/tan(sun_elevation); use only elevation>0; obstruction/ray test required
sun.orientation: Photo backdrop/subject relative to sun evaluated per session; ceremony guests avoid direct glare; stage orientation balances sun/glare against acoustic/site/egress constraints; never a universal east/west rule

weather.provenance: Observed/forecast/simulated; retain issue time and valid time; stale never labelled live; beyond forecast horizon use named scenarios

approval_rule: No all-clear/safe/certified label from geometry heuristics. Every review has person/scope/date, selected code edition, installation/configuration and expiry. Immutable client snapshot records unresolved items.
large_event_rule: 2000/10000 cases are multiple zones with local service banks and independent routes; no linear enlargement of one tent/one queue/one gate.
